name: Desiccated coconut
description: Coconut flesh grated and dried — the baking and mithai staple.

tcm.note: Read with coconut; no classical Chinese entry.

ayurveda.note: Narikela is shita and guru; drying does not change its virya.

histamine.note: Low; it goes rancid quietly, which is a fat problem rather than a histamine one.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
